text: Binance started as a simple crypto to crypto exchange. From the start, we wanted to do things differently by providing robust customer service, acting on user feedback and continuously improving our offerings. Word quickly spread. Within five months, we were the most widely used crypto exchange in the world. From there, we invested our success into growing the ecosystem and making it more collaborative, collaborative and inclusive by creating platforms to identify and empower other innovative crypto and blockchain projects. These were some of the first steps we took towards increasing the freedom of money for people around the world, an initiative we're still just getting started on. As we neared our first anniversary, we launched our first partner Fiat to Crypto exchange, bringing digital currency to an underserved market and bridging the worlds of cash and crypto. Weeks later, we launched the first blockchain powered nonprofit to increase transparency, efficiency, efficiency and accountability in charitable giving. As well as two free learning centers dedicated to expanding crypto and blockchain knowledge. In 2019, we continued our ecosystem focus, launching the community driven Binance chain, blockchain and decentralized services delivering new levels of freedom to our users. Meanwhile, Binance Coin reached number six by market cap, one of the highest ever reached by a utility token. And we introduced the Venus project to develop localized stablecoins worldwide in parallel with a host of fiat initiatives, initiatives to reduce the barriers of entry to crypto for all users. Along the way, we added new services and features to the Binance exchange, like margin and futures trading and savings and staking programs, delivering key requested features to our users. Three years in and one thing is clear. At Binance, we're committed to advancing the crypto cause, growing together with our community and powering the next generation of innovators with open platform initiatives designed to build key crypto infrastructure. We aim to support all popular currencies by the end of the year, providing even more ways for people to access crypto in order to increase the freedom of money for people around the world. So thank you for helping make our vision possible. We can't wait to show you what's next. Let's take crypto off the charts together.
